- [LDIA.3.3.7] **A deferred capability set `true`** → compile error, at the
  `use` block line: `DS_VALIDATE_REALTIME_DEFERRED` for `realtime` or
  `constspace` ([LCAP.2.1.5]), and `DS_VALIDATE_CAPABILITY_DEFERRED` for a
  storage or samples-plane capability ([LCAP.2.10]). A line setting any of
  them `false` is permitted. The compiler makes this check before the
  constraint check ([LDIA.3.5]), so a deferred setting is reported as
  deferred whatever else the block sets.
